SELECT o.job_order_id AS id, o.job_no, COALESCE(s.external_ref, '') AS external_ref,
       COALESCE(o.command, '') AS command, o.dispatch_status, o.equipment_id,
       COALESCE(r.product_definition_id, '') AS product_definition_id, r.quantity, COALESCE(r.uom, '') AS uom,
       o.planned_start, o.planned_end, o.created_at
FROM emc_job_order o
JOIN emc_work_request r ON r.request_id = o.request_id
JOIN emc_work_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id
WHERE o.dispatch_status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'ABORTED', 'CANCELLED')
ORDER BY o.planned_start ASC, o.job_no

reports.title: Inventory Stock (Material Lots)
reports.description: Material lots with quantity, status and location (Part 2 material lot).
reports.query:
SELECT l.lot_id, l.barcode, l.definition_id AS material_id, COALESCE(d.class_id, '') AS class_id,
       l.quantity, l.base_uom AS uom, l.status, COALESCE(l.storage_location, '') AS storage_location
FROM emc_material_lot l JOIN emc_material_definition d ON d.definition_id = l.definition_id
ORDER BY l.lot_id

reports.title: Material Movement (Material Actual)
reports.description: Consumed / produced / moved / scrapped material actuals per job order (Part 4).
reports.query:
SELECT a.recorded_at, r.job_no, a.material_use, COALESCE(a.lot_id, '') AS lot_id,
       COALESCE(a.definition_id, '') AS material_id, a.quantity, COALESCE(a.uom, '') AS uom
FROM emc_material_actual a
JOIN emc_job_response r ON r.response_id = a.response_id
ORDER BY a.recorded_at DESC

reports.title: Quality Defects
reports.description: Defect log with QA workflow status (Part 3 quality operations).
reports.query:
SELECT defect_no, job_no, defect_type_id, qty_declared, severity, status,
       COALESCE(reason_code, '') AS reason_code, COALESCE(created_by, '') AS created_by, created_at
FROM emc_defect_record
ORDER BY created_at DESC

reports.title: OEE by Shift (ISO 22400 subset)
reports.description: Availability / Performance / Quality / OEE per equipment per shift.
reports.query:
SELECT equipment_id, shift_label, planned_min, availability_loss_min, performance_loss_min,
       produced_qty, good_qty, availability_pct, performance_pct, quality_pct, oee_pct, calculated_at
FROM emc_oee_shift
ORDER BY calculated_at DESC

reports.title: Material Catalog
reports.description: Material definitions as code/name options for form dropdowns.
reports.query:
SELECT definition_id AS code, COALESCE(description, '') AS name,
       COALESCE(class_id, '') AS class_id, kind, base_uom
FROM emc_material_definition
ORDER BY definition_id

reports.title: Equipment Catalog
reports.description: Equipment hierarchy as code/name options for form dropdowns.
reports.query:
SELECT equipment_id AS code, COALESCE(description, '') AS name,
       equipment_level, COALESCE(parent_id, '') AS parent_id
FROM emc_equipment
ORDER BY hierarchy_path

reports.title: Personnel Catalog
reports.description: Persons as code/name options for form dropdowns.
reports.query:
SELECT person_id AS code, person_name AS name, COALESCE(personnel_class_id, '') AS personnel_class_id
FROM emc_person
ORDER BY person_id

reports.title: Defect Type Catalog
reports.description: Defect types as code/name options for form dropdowns.
reports.query:
SELECT defect_type_id AS code, COALESCE(description, '') AS name, COALESCE(category, '') AS category
FROM emc_defect_type
ORDER BY defect_type_id

reports.title: Reason Code Catalog
reports.description: Reason codes as code/name options for form dropdowns.
reports.query:
SELECT reason_code AS code, COALESCE(description, '') AS name
FROM emc_reason_code
ORDER BY reason_code

reports.title: Event Definition Catalog
reports.description: Operations event definitions as code/name options for form dropdowns.
reports.query:
SELECT code, name, event_class, oee_bucket
FROM emc_operations_event_definition
ORDER BY sort_order

reports.title: Shift Catalog
reports.description: Calendar shifts as code/name options for form dropdowns.
reports.query:
SELECT shift_id AS code, shift_label AS name, equipment_id, state
FROM emc_work_calendar
ORDER BY shift_id

reports.title: Operations Event Journal
reports.description: Registered operations events with definition names and OEE buckets.
reports.query:
SELECT e.event_id AS id, e.definition_code, d.name, d.oee_bucket,
       COALESCE(e.job_no, '') AS job_no, COALESCE(e.equipment_id, '') AS equipment_id,
       e.time_min, e.status, e.started_at, e.ended_at
FROM emc_operations_event e
JOIN emc_operations_event_definition d ON d.code = e.definition_code
ORDER BY e.started_at DESC

reports.title: Lot Genealogy Edges
reports.description: Lot→lot edges for the selected lot (direct incident edges).
reports.query:
SELECT g.input_lot_id, COALESCE(li.definition_id, '') AS input_material,
       g.output_lot_id, COALESCE(lo.definition_id, '') AS output_material,
       g.quantity, g.created_at
FROM emc_lot_genealogy g
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot li ON li.lot_id = g.input_lot_id
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot lo ON lo.lot_id = g.output_lot_id
WHERE ? <> '' AND (g.input_lot_id = ? OR g.output_lot_id = ?)
ORDER BY g.created_at, g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id

reports.title: Reverse Trace (selected lot → Raw)
reports.description: Multi-level UPSTREAM tree for the selected lotId only.
reports.query:
WITH RECURSIVE upstream (root_lot, lot_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, definition_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT g.output_lot_id, g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''), 1,
         CONCAT(g.output_lot_id, '>', g.input_lot_id)
  FROM emc_lot_genealogy g
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.input_lot_id
  WHERE ? <> '' AND g.output_lot_id = ?
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.root_lot, g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''),
         u.depth + 1, CONCAT(u.path, '>', g.input_lot_id)
  FROM upstream u
  JOIN emc_lot_genealogy g ON g.output_lot_id = u.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.input_lot_id
  WHERE u.depth < 15
)
SELECT root_lot, depth, lot_id, definition_id AS material_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, path
FROM upstream
ORDER BY depth, lot_id

reports.title: Forward Trace (selected lot → FG)
reports.description: Multi-level DOWNSTREAM tree for the selected lotId only.
reports.query:
WITH RECURSIVE downstream (root_lot, lot_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, definition_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id, g.input_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''), 1,
         CONCAT(g.input_lot_id, '>', g.output_lot_id)
  FROM emc_lot_genealogy g
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.output_lot_id
  WHERE ? <> '' AND g.input_lot_id = ?
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.root_lot, g.output_lot_id, g.input_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''),
         d.depth + 1, CONCAT(d.path, '>', g.output_lot_id)
  FROM downstream d
  JOIN emc_lot_genealogy g ON g.input_lot_id = d.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.output_lot_id
  WHERE d.depth < 15
)
SELECT root_lot, depth, lot_id, definition_id AS material_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, path
FROM downstream
ORDER BY depth, lot_id

reports.title: Genealogy Lot Catalog
reports.description: Selectable demo lots for genealogy (FG / WIP / RAW).
reports.query:
SELECT lot_id, barcode, definition_id AS material_id, status, storage_location, quantity, base_uom
FROM emc_material_lot
WHERE lot_id LIKE 'LOT-FG-%' OR lot_id LIKE 'LOT-WIP-%' OR lot_id LIKE 'LOT-RAW-%'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN lot_id LIKE 'LOT-FG-%' THEN 1 WHEN lot_id LIKE 'LOT-WIP-%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, lot_id

reports.title: Job ↔ Lot Links
reports.description: Produced FG lots per job (select job → sets lotId for genealogy).
reports.query:
SELECT j.job_no, j.lot_id, j.link_role,
       COALESCE(l.definition_id, '') AS material_id, COALESCE(l.status, '') AS lot_status,
       COALESCE(o.dispatch_status, '') AS dispatch_status
FROM emc_job_lot_link j
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = j.lot_id
LEFT JOIN emc_job_order o ON o.job_no = j.job_no
WHERE j.link_role = 'PRODUCED' AND j.lot_id LIKE 'LOT-FG-%'
ORDER BY j.job_no, j.lot_id

reports.title: Genealogy Mass Balance (Actuals)
reports.description: Consumed vs produced quantities from material actuals (mass-balance view).
reports.query:
SELECT COALESCE(a.definition_id, '') AS material_id, a.material_use,
       SUM(a.quantity) AS qty, COALESCE(MAX(a.uom), '') AS uom,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_n
FROM emc_material_actual a
GROUP BY a.definition_id, a.material_use
ORDER BY a.definition_id, a.material_use

reports.title: MOM Activity Matrix (IEC 62264-3)
reports.description: Part 3 4×8 activity coverage: Production/Quality/Inventory/Maintenance × 8 activities.
reports.query:
SELECT domain, activity, status, COALESCE(note, '') AS note, COALESCE(ui_link, '') AS ui_link
FROM emc_mom_activity
ORDER BY CASE domain
  WHEN 'PRODUCTION' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUALITY' THEN 2 WHEN 'INVENTORY' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  CASE activity
  WHEN 'DEFINITION' THEN 1 WHEN 'RESOURCE' THEN 2 WHEN 'DETAILED_SCHEDULING' THEN 3
  WHEN 'DISPATCHING' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXECUTION' THEN 5 WHEN 'DATA_COLLECTION' THEN 6
  WHEN 'TRACKING' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END

reports.title: Physical Assets (Part 2)
reports.description: Physical asset register linked to equipment hierarchy.
reports.query:
SELECT a.asset_id, COALESCE(a.class_id, '') AS class_id, COALESCE(a.equipment_id, '') AS equipment_id,
       COALESCE(a.serial_no, '') AS serial_no, COALESCE(a.manufacturer, '') AS manufacturer,
       COALESCE(a.description, '') AS description, a.status
FROM emc_physical_asset a ORDER BY a.asset_id

reports.title: Product Definitions (Part 2)
reports.description: Product definitions with FG material and process segments.
reports.query:
SELECT p.product_id, COALESCE(p.description, '') AS description,
       COALESCE(p.fg_definition_id, '') AS fg_definition_id, p.status,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emc_product_segment ps WHERE ps.product_id = p.product_id) AS segments
FROM emc_product_definition p ORDER BY p.product_id

reports.title: Operations Capability (Part 4)
reports.description: What each work unit is capable of running.
reports.query:
SELECT capability_id, operations_type, COALESCE(equipment_id, '') AS equipment_id,
       COALESCE(segment_id, '') AS segment_id, COALESCE(reason, '') AS reason, status
FROM emc_operations_capability ORDER BY capability_id

reports.title: Capability Test Results (Part 2)
reports.description: Capability test specs and latest results.
reports.query:
SELECT s.spec_id, s.target_kind, s.target_id, s.test_name, COALESCE(s.criterion, '') AS criterion,
       COALESCE(r.measured_value, '') AS measured_value, COALESCE(r.result, '') AS result,
       r.tested_at
FROM emc_capability_test_spec s
LEFT JOIN emc_capability_test_result r ON r.spec_id = s.spec_id
ORDER BY s.spec_id, r.tested_at DESC

reports.title: Operational Locations (Part 2)
reports.description: Operational locations linked to equipment / storage hierarchy.
reports.query:
SELECT location_id, COALESCE(description, '') AS description, location_kind,
       COALESCE(equipment_id, '') AS equipment_id, COALESCE(parent_location_id, '') AS parent_location_id,
       status
FROM emc_operational_location ORDER BY location_id

reports.title: Domain Schedules (Part 3)
reports.description: Detailed scheduling across Production / Quality / Inventory / Maintenance.
reports.query:
SELECT schedule_id, domain, schedule_kind, COALESCE(target_id, '') AS target_id,
       quantity, COALESCE(uom, '') AS uom, status, COALESCE(note, '') AS note
FROM emc_domain_schedule
ORDER BY CASE domain
  WHEN 'PRODUCTION' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUALITY' THEN 2 WHEN 'INVENTORY' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  schedule_id

reports.title: Quality Defect Rate KPI
reports.description: Defect counts and share of jobs with defects (Part 3 performance analysis).
reports.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS defect_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(qty_confirmed, qty_declared)), 0) AS confirmed_qty,
       COUNT(DISTINCT job_no) AS jobs_with_defects,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emc_job_order) AS job_count,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emc_job_order) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT job_no) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emc_job_order), 2)
       END AS defect_rate_pct
FROM emc_defect_record

reports.title: Inventory Turns KPI
reports.description: Approx inventory turns from stock vs consumed actuals.
reports.query:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM emc_material_lot WHERE status = 'STOCK'), 0) AS stock_qty,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM emc_material_actual WHERE material_use = 'CONSUMED'), 0) AS consumed_qty,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM emc_material_actual WHERE material_use = 'PRODUCED'), 0) AS produced_qty,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM emc_material_lot WHERE status = 'STOCK'), 0) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM emc_material_actual WHERE material_use = 'CONSUMED'), 0)
                 / (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM emc_material_lot WHERE status = 'STOCK'), 3)
       END AS turns_approx

reports.title: Maintenance MTTR / MTBF
reports.description: MTTR from closed downtime events; MTBF heuristic from shift calendar.
reports.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS closed_events,
       COALESCE(SUM(time_min), 0) AS total_downtime_min,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(time_min), 0) / COUNT(*), 2) END AS mttr_min,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <= 1 THEN 480
            ELSE ROUND(480.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT equipment_id) FROM emc_work_calendar) / COUNT(*), 2)
       END AS mtbf_min
FROM emc_operations_event
WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND COALESCE(time_min, 0) > 0

reports.title: Resource Relationship Networks (Part 4)
reports.description: GOST / IEC 62264-4 Resource Relationship Network headers.
reports.query:
SELECT network_id, name, COALESCE(description, '') AS description,
       COALESCE(hierarchy_scope_id, '') AS hierarchy_scope_id, status
FROM emc_resource_relationship_network ORDER BY network_id

reports.title: RRN Edges (Part 4)
reports.description: Resource relationships (equipment↔tool/container/software).
reports.query:
SELECT rel_id, network_id, from_resource_type, from_resource_id,
       to_resource_type, to_resource_id, relationship_type, dependency
FROM emc_resource_relationship ORDER BY network_id, rel_id

reports.title: Containers (Part 2 §5.6)
reports.description: Container resources (GOST R IEC 62264-2).
reports.query:
SELECT container_id, class_id, name, COALESCE(description, '') AS description,
       COALESCE(hierarchy_scope_id, '') AS hierarchy_scope_id,
       COALESCE(CAST(capacity AS VARCHAR), '') AS capacity,
       COALESCE(capacity_uom, '') AS capacity_uom, status
FROM emc_container ORDER BY container_id

reports.title: Tools (Part 2 §5.6)
reports.description: Tool resources linked to equipment.
reports.query:
SELECT tool_id, class_id, name, COALESCE(description, '') AS description,
       COALESCE(equipment_id, '') AS equipment_id,
       COALESCE(CAST(calibration_due AS VARCHAR), '') AS calibration_due, status
FROM emc_tool ORDER BY tool_id

reports.title: Software (Part 2 §5.6)
reports.description: Software resources (MES agents / control software).
reports.query:
SELECT software_id, class_id, name, COALESCE(vendor, '') AS vendor,
       COALESCE(version_label, '') AS version_label, status
FROM emc_software ORDER BY software_id

reports.title: Operations Definitions (Part 2)
reports.description: First-class Operations Definition headers.
reports.query:
SELECT definition_id, version, name, COALESCE(description, '') AS description,
       published_flag, status,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emc_operations_definition_segment s
        WHERE s.definition_id = d.definition_id AND s.version = d.version) AS segments
FROM emc_operations_definition d ORDER BY definition_id, version

reports.title: Operations Schedules (Part 2)
reports.description: Operations Schedule + request count.
reports.query:
SELECT s.schedule_id, s.name, s.state, COALESCE(s.description, '') AS description,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emc_operations_request r WHERE r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id) AS requests
FROM emc_operations_schedule s ORDER BY s.schedule_id

reports.title: Work Capability (Part 4)
reports.description: Work Capability headers (distinct from Operations Capability).
reports.query:
SELECT capability_id, name, COALESCE(description, '') AS description,
       COALESCE(hierarchy_scope_id, '') AS hierarchy_scope_id, status
FROM emc_work_capability ORDER BY capability_id

reports.title: Work Master Capability (Part 4)
reports.description: Work Master ↔ Work Capability links.
reports.query:
SELECT work_master_id, version, capability_id
FROM emc_work_master_capability ORDER BY work_master_id, version, capability_id

reports.title: Work Alerts (Part 4)
reports.description: Work Alert register.
reports.query:
SELECT alert_id, alert_type, severity, COALESCE(work_master_id, '') AS work_master_id,
       message, status, CAST(raised_at AS VARCHAR) AS raised_at,
       COALESCE(ack_by, '') AS ack_by
FROM emc_work_alert ORDER BY raised_at DESC

reports.title: Work KPI Values (ISO 22400)
reports.description: Calculated / seeded KPI values (Part 4 Work KPI).
reports.query:
SELECT v.kpi_code, d.name, COALESCE(v.scope_id, '') AS scope_id,
       COALESCE(v.period_label, '') AS period_label, v.value_num,
       CAST(v.calculated_at AS VARCHAR) AS calculated_at
FROM emc_kpi_value v
LEFT JOIN emc_kpi_definition d ON d.kpi_code = v.kpi_code
ORDER BY v.calculated_at DESC

reports.title: Maintenance Requests
reports.description: Maintenance requests and linked work orders.
reports.query:
SELECT r.request_id, r.equipment_id, COALESCE(r.description, '') AS description,
       r.priority, r.status,
       COALESCE((SELECT w.wo_id FROM emc_maintenance_work_order w
                 WHERE w.request_id = r.request_id LIMIT 1), '') AS wo_id,
       CAST(r.created_at AS VARCHAR) AS created_at
FROM emc_maintenance_request r ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

reports.title: Inventory Documents
reports.description: Inventory movement documents (Part 3 Inventory).
reports.query:
SELECT d.doc_id, d.kind, d.status,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emc_inventory_document_line l WHERE l.doc_id = d.doc_id) AS lines,
       COALESCE(d.operator_person_id, '') AS operator_person_id,
       CAST(d.created_at AS VARCHAR) AS created_at
FROM emc_inventory_document d ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

reports.title: QA Test Results
reports.description: Quality test results (Part 3 Quality).
reports.query:
SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, COALESCE(job_no, '') AS job_no,
       COALESCE(lot_id, '') AS lot_id, test_name, result,
       COALESCE(measurements_json, '') AS measurements_json,
       CAST(created_at AS VARCHAR) AS created_at
FROM emc_qa_test_result ORDER BY created_at DESC

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "lot", "sql": "SELECT lot_id, COALESCE(disposition, '') AS disposition FROM emc_material_lot WHERE lot_id = ?", "params": ["${input.lotId}"]}, {"type": "failIfNull", "var": "lot", "error_code": "LOT_NOT_FOUND", "error_message": "Lot not found"}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "guard", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (VALUES ('QUARANTINE'), ('RELEASED')) v(d) WHERE d = ?", "params": ["${lot.disposition}"]}, {"type": "failIfNotEquals", "var": "guard.cnt", "equals": "1", "error_code": "INVALID_STATE", "error_message": "Reject allowed from QUARANTINE or RELEASED"}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "UPDATE emc_material_lot SET disposition = 'REJECTED', status = 'BLOCKED_QC', storage_location = 'WH-REJ', version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE lot_id = ?", "params": ["${input.lotId}"]}, {"type": "exec", "sql": "INSERT INTO pha_esign_record (id, entity_type, entity_id, signer, meaning, comment_text) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'LOT', ?, ?, 'REVIEWED', NULLIF(?, ''))", "params": ["${input.lotId}", "${input.by}", "${input.reason}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "lotId": "${input.lotId}", "disposition": "REJECTED"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "br", "sql": "SELECT batch_run_id, recipe_id, status FROM pha_batch_run WHERE batch_run_id = ?", "params": ["${input.batchRunId}"]}, {"type": "failIfNull", "var": "br", "error_code": "NOT_FOUND", "error_message": "Batch run not found"}, {"type": "selectOne", "var": "ph", "sql": "SELECT phase_seq, phase_code FROM pha_recipe_phase WHERE recipe_id = ? reports.title: Pharma Job Board (ISA-95/ISA-88)
reports.description: Active job orders on solid dosage and packaging lines with dispatch status.
reports.query:
SELECT o.job_order_id AS id, o.job_no, COALESCE(s.external_ref, '') AS external_ref,
       COALESCE(o.command, '') AS command, o.dispatch_status, o.equipment_id,
       COALESCE(r.product_definition_id, '') AS product_definition_id, r.quantity, COALESCE(r.uom, '') AS uom,
       o.planned_start, o.planned_end, o.created_at
FROM emc_job_order o
JOIN emc_work_request r ON r.request_id = o.request_id
JOIN emc_work_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id
WHERE o.dispatch_status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'ABORTED', 'CANCELLED')
  AND o.equipment_id IN ('DSP-01', 'GRN-01', 'FBD-01', 'BLN-01', 'TPR-01', 'COT-01', 'BLS-01', 'CRT-01')
ORDER BY o.planned_start ASC, o.job_no

reports.title: Quarantine & Batch Release
reports.description: Lots in QUARANTINE disposition with GTIN, batch number and expiry date.
reports.query:
SELECT l.lot_id, l.barcode, l.definition_id AS material_id, l.status,
       COALESCE(l.disposition, '') AS disposition, l.quantity, l.base_uom AS uom,
       COALESCE(l.storage_location, '') AS storage_location,
       COALESCE(pb.prop_value, '') AS batch_no, COALESCE(pg.prop_value, '') AS gtin,
       COALESCE(pe.prop_value, '') AS expiry_date
FROM emc_material_lot l
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot_property pb ON pb.lot_id = l.lot_id AND pb.prop_key = 'batch_no'
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot_property pg ON pg.lot_id = l.lot_id AND pg.prop_key = 'gtin'
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot_property pe ON pe.lot_id = l.lot_id AND pe.prop_key = 'expiry_date'
WHERE l.disposition = 'QUARANTINE'
ORDER BY l.lot_id

reports.title: Reverse Trace FG (Pharma)
reports.description: Multi-level UPSTREAM tree for quarantine FG lot LOT-FG-PH-0001.
reports.query:
WITH RECURSIVE upstream (lot_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, definition_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''), 1,
         CONCAT(g.output_lot_id, '<', g.input_lot_id)
  FROM emc_lot_genealogy g
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.input_lot_id
  WHERE g.output_lot_id = 'LOT-FG-PH-0001'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''),
         u.depth + 1, CONCAT(u.path, '<', g.input_lot_id)
  FROM upstream u
  JOIN emc_lot_genealogy g ON g.output_lot_id = u.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.input_lot_id
  WHERE u.depth < 15
)
SELECT depth, lot_id, definition_id AS material_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, path
FROM upstream ORDER BY depth, lot_id

reports.title: Forward Trace API (Pharma)
reports.description: Multi-level DOWNSTREAM tree for API lot LOT-API-0001.
reports.query:
WITH RECURSIVE downstream (lot_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, definition_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT g.output_lot_id, g.input_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''), 1,
         CONCAT(g.input_lot_id, '>', g.output_lot_id)
  FROM emc_lot_genealogy g
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.output_lot_id
  WHERE g.input_lot_id = 'LOT-API-0001'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.output_lot_id, g.input_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''),
         d.depth + 1, CONCAT(d.path, '>', g.output_lot_id)
  FROM downstream d
  JOIN emc_lot_genealogy g ON g.input_lot_id = d.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.output_lot_id
  WHERE d.depth < 15
)
SELECT depth, lot_id, definition_id AS material_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, path
FROM downstream ORDER BY depth, lot_id

reports.title: Print Job Board (ISA-95 Job Orders)
reports.description: Active job orders on printing equipment with dispatch status (Part 4 job list).
reports.query:
SELECT o.job_order_id AS id, o.job_no, COALESCE(s.external_ref, '') AS external_ref,
       COALESCE(o.command, '') AS command, o.dispatch_status, o.equipment_id,
       COALESCE(r.product_definition_id, '') AS product_definition_id, r.quantity, COALESCE(r.uom, '') AS uom,
       o.planned_start, o.planned_end, o.created_at
FROM emc_job_order o
JOIN emc_work_request r ON r.request_id = o.request_id
JOIN emc_work_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id
WHERE o.dispatch_status NOT IN ('ENDED', 'ABORTED', 'CANCELLED')
  AND o.equipment_id IN ('PR120', 'PR130', 'LM210', 'SL300', 'RW100')
ORDER BY o.planned_start ASC, o.job_no

reports.title: Downtime by Event Code (Flexibase catalog)
reports.description: Operations events aggregated by definition code with Flexibase section.
reports.query:
SELECT d.code, d.name, COALESCE(x.section, '') AS section, COUNT(*) AS events,
       COALESCE(SUM(e.time_min), 0) AS total_time_min
FROM emc_operations_event e
JOIN emc_operations_event_definition d ON d.code = e.definition_code
LEFT JOIN emp_eventdef_ext x ON x.code = d.code
WHERE e.status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED')
GROUP BY d.code, d.name, x.section
ORDER BY total_time_min DESC, d.code

reports.title: Roll & Material Stock
reports.description: Material lots (rolls and ink cans) with roll dimensions from lot properties.
reports.query:
SELECT l.lot_id, l.barcode, l.definition_id AS material_id, COALESCE(d.class_id, '') AS class_id,
       l.status, COALESCE(l.storage_location, '') AS storage_location,
       l.quantity, l.base_uom AS uom, l.length_m, l.weight_kg,
       COALESCE(w.prop_value, '') AS width_mm, COALESCE(t.prop_value, '') AS thickness_mkm
FROM emc_material_lot l
JOIN emc_material_definition d ON d.definition_id = l.definition_id
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot_property w ON w.lot_id = l.lot_id AND w.prop_key = 'width_mm'
LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot_property t ON t.lot_id = l.lot_id AND t.prop_key = 'thickness_mkm'
ORDER BY l.lot_id

reports.title: Reverse Trace FG Sleeve
reports.description: Multi-level UPSTREAM tree for LOT-FG-SLV-0001 (film→print→lam→sleeve).
reports.query:
WITH RECURSIVE upstream (lot_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, definition_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''), 1,
         CONCAT(g.output_lot_id, '<', g.input_lot_id)
  FROM emc_lot_genealogy g
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.input_lot_id
  WHERE g.output_lot_id = 'LOT-FG-SLV-0001'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.input_lot_id, g.output_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''),
         u.depth + 1, CONCAT(u.path, '<', g.input_lot_id)
  FROM upstream u
  JOIN emc_lot_genealogy g ON g.output_lot_id = u.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.input_lot_id
  WHERE u.depth < 15
)
SELECT depth, lot_id, definition_id AS material_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, path
FROM upstream ORDER BY depth, lot_id

reports.title: Forward Trace Film
reports.description: Multi-level DOWNSTREAM tree for LOT-FILM-0001.
reports.query:
WITH RECURSIVE downstream (lot_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, definition_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT g.output_lot_id, g.input_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''), 1,
         CONCAT(g.input_lot_id, '>', g.output_lot_id)
  FROM emc_lot_genealogy g
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.output_lot_id
  WHERE g.input_lot_id = 'LOT-FILM-0001'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.output_lot_id, g.input_lot_id, g.quantity, COALESCE(l.definition_id, ''),
         d.depth + 1, CONCAT(d.path, '>', g.output_lot_id)
  FROM downstream d
  JOIN emc_lot_genealogy g ON g.input_lot_id = d.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN emc_material_lot l ON l.lot_id = g.output_lot_id
  WHERE d.depth < 15
)
SELECT depth, lot_id, definition_id AS material_id, linked_from_lot_id, quantity, path
FROM downstream ORDER BY depth, lot_id

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"event","sql":"SELECT e.id::text AS event_id, e.line_code, e.volume_kg::text AS volume_kg, l.line_type FROM mes_defect_event e JOIN mes_line l ON l.line_code = e.line_code WHERE e.status = 'pending' ORDER BY e.created_at ASC LIMIT 1"},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"event","message":"No pending defect event"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_defect_event SET status = 'processing' WHERE id = ?::uuid","params":["${event.event_id}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_hub_context SET current_event_id = ?::uuid, line_type = ?, is_transitional = false WHERE id = 1","params":["${event.event_id}","${event.line_type}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","eventId":"${event.event_id}","lineCode":"${event.line_code}","lineType":"${event.line_type}","volumeKg":"${event.volume_kg}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_defect_event e SET order_no = CASE WHEN e.order_scenario = 'closing' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_order o WHERE o.line_code = e.line_code AND o.status = 'closing') THEN COALESCE((SELECT order_no FROM mes_order WHERE line_code = e.line_code AND status = 'closing' ORDER BY order_no DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT order_no FROM mes_order WHERE line_code = e.line_code AND status IN ('open','in_progress') ORDER BY order_no DESC LIMIT 1)) ELSE (SELECT order_no FROM mes_order WHERE line_code = e.line_code AND status IN ('open','in_progress') ORDER BY order_no DESC LIMIT 1) END, is_transitional_remainder = CASE WHEN (e.order_scenario = 'closing' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_order o WHERE o.line_code = e.line_code AND o.status = 'closing')) AND (e.volume_kg > 10 OR COALESCE((SELECT l.unit_a_busy FROM mes_line l WHERE l.line_code = e.line_code), false) = true) THEN true ELSE false END WHERE e.id = (SELECT current_event_id FROM mes_hub_context WHERE id = 1)"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_hub_context SET is_transitional = (SELECT e.is_transitional_remainder FROM mes_defect_event e WHERE e.id = current_event_id), line_type = (SELECT l.line_type FROM mes_defect_event e JOIN mes_line l ON l.line_code = e.line_code WHERE e.id = current_event_id) WHERE id = 1"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"resolved","sql":"SELECT e.id::text AS event_id, e.order_no, e.is_transitional_remainder::text AS is_transitional, l.line_type FROM mes_defect_event e JOIN mes_line l ON l.line_code = e.line_code WHERE e.id = (SELECT current_event_id FROM mes_hub_context WHERE id = 1)"},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"resolved","message":"Defect event not found"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","eventId":"${resolved.event_id}","orderNo":"${resolved.order_no}","isTransitionalRemainder":"${resolved.is_transitional}","lineType":"${resolved.line_type}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"route","sql":"SELECT e.id::text AS event_id, CASE WHEN l.line_type = 'A' AND (l.unit_a_busy = true OR e.volume_kg > 10) THEN 'PEER_LINE' WHEN l.line_type = 'A' THEN 'REWORK_A' WHEN l.line_type = 'B' AND e.volume_kg > (l.feed_capacity_pct / 10.0) THEN 'FEED_QUEUE' WHEN l.line_type = 'B' THEN 'FEED_B' WHEN l.line_type = 'D' AND e.is_special_scrap = true THEN 'SPECIAL_ROUTE' ELSE 'TRANSPORT_HUB' END AS route_type, CASE WHEN l.line_type = 'A' AND (l.unit_a_busy = true OR e.volume_kg > 10) THEN 'PEER' WHEN l.line_type = 'A' THEN 'REWORK_A' WHEN l.line_type = 'B' AND e.volume_kg > (l.feed_capacity_pct / 10.0) THEN 'FEED_QUEUE' WHEN l.line_type = 'B' THEN 'FEED_B' WHEN l.line_type = 'D' AND e.is_special_scrap = true THEN 'SPECIAL_ROUTE' ELSE 'TRANSPORT_HUB' END AS target, (CASE WHEN l.line_type = 'D' AND e.is_special_scrap = false AND l.transport_load_pct > 70 THEN 3 WHEN l.line_type = 'D' AND e.is_special_scrap = false AND l.transport_load_pct > 40 THEN 2 WHEN l.line_type = 'A' AND (l.unit_a_busy = true OR e.volume_kg > 10) THEN 2 WHEN l.line_type = 'B' AND e.volume_kg > (l.feed_capacity_pct / 10.0) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)::text AS priority, CASE WHEN l.line_type = 'D' AND e.is_special_scrap = true THEN 'Demo: special scrap — alternate route' WHEN l.line_type = 'D' THEN 'Demo: transport to reprocessing hub' WHEN l.line_type = 'B' AND e.volume_kg > (l.feed_capacity_pct / 10.0) THEN 'Demo: feed capacity exceeded — queue' WHEN l.line_type = 'B' THEN 'Demo: feed on line B' WHEN l.line_type = 'A' AND (l.unit_a_busy = true OR e.volume_kg > 10) THEN 'Demo: rework unit busy — peer line' ELSE 'Demo: rework on line A' END AS rationale FROM mes_defect_event e JOIN mes_line l ON l.line_code = e.line_code WHERE e.id = (SELECT current_event_id FROM mes_hub_context WHERE id = 1)"},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"route","message":"Event not found for route calculation"},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO mes_recommendation (id, event_id, route_type, target, priority, rationale, status) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?::uuid, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'recommended')","params":["${route.event_id}","${route.route_type}","${route.target}","${route.priority}","${route.rationale}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_defect_event SET status = 'recommended' WHERE id = ?::uuid","params":["${route.event_id}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE mes_hub_context SET route_target = ?, route_priority = ?, route_rationale = ? WHERE id = 1","params":["${route.target}","${route.priority}","${route.rationale}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","eventId":"${route.event_id}","routeType":"${route.route_type}","target":"${route.target}","priority":"${route.priority}","rationale":"${route.rationale}"}}]}

workflows.bpmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
             xmlns:ispf="http://ispf.io/bpmn"
             targetNamespace="http://ispf.io/bpmn">
  <process id="mes-defect-distribution" name="MES Defect Distribution" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start" name="Start"/>
    <serviceTask id="receiveDefect" name="Receive defect event"
                 ispf:action="invoke_function"
                 ispf:objectPath="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
                 ispf:functionName="mes_receiveDefect"
                 ispf:outputMap="eventId=eventId,lineCode=lineCode"/>
    <serviceTask id="resolveOrder" name="Resolve order binding"
                 ispf:action="invoke_function"
                 ispf:objectPath="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
                 ispf:functionName="mes_resolveOrder"
                 ispf:inputMap="eventId=${eventId}"
                 ispf:outputMap="orderNo=orderNo"/>
    <exclusiveGateway id="gwTransitional" name="Transitional remainder?"/>
    <serviceTask id="markTransitional" name="Account transitional remainder"
                 ispf:action="log"
                 ispf:message="mes-defect: transitional remainder accounted"/>
    <serviceTask id="markCurrentOrder" name="Bind to current order"
                 ispf:action="log"
                 ispf:message="mes-defect: bound to current order"/>
    <exclusiveGateway id="gwJoinOrder" name="Join order branch"/>
    <serviceTask id="calcRoute" name="Forecast route"
                 ispf:action="invoke_function"
                 ispf:objectPath="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
                 ispf:functionName="mes_calculateRoute"
                 ispf:inputMap="eventId=${eventId}"/>
    <exclusiveGateway id="gwUserTask" name="Operator task by line type"/>
    <userTask id="confirmTypeA" name="Confirm type A route"
              ispf:title="Подтвердите маршрут переработки (тип A)"
              ispf:instructions="Проверьте рекомендацию и подтвердите переработку на линии или перенос на соседнюю линию"
              ispf:assigneeRole="operator"
              ispf:targetObject="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
              ispf:function="mes_confirmRoute"/>
    <userTask id="confirmTypeB" name="Confirm type B route"
              ispf:title="Подтвердите маршрут подачи (тип B)"
              ispf:instructions="Проверьте рекомендацию и подтвердите подачу или постановку в очередь"
              ispf:assigneeRole="operator"
              ispf:targetObject="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
              ispf:function="mes_confirmRoute"/>
    <userTask id="confirmTypeD" name="Confirm type D route"
              ispf:title="Подтвердите транспортный маршрут (тип D)"
              ispf:instructions="Проверьте маршрут доставки и подтвердите транспортную задачу"
              ispf:assigneeRole="operator"
              ispf:targetObject="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
              ispf:function="mes_confirmRoute"/>
    <exclusiveGateway id="gwJoinConfirm" name="Join confirm branch"/>
    <serviceTask id="finalizeDefect" name="Finalize distribution"
                 ispf:action="invoke_function"
                 ispf:objectPath="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
                 ispf:functionName="mes_finalizeDefect"
                 ispf:inputMap="eventId=${eventId}"/>
    <serviceTask id="notifyRouted" name="Notify MES routed"
                 ispf:action="fire_event"
                 ispf:objectPath="root.platform.devices.mes-hub-01"
                 ispf:eventName="mesDefectRouted"/>
    <endEvent id="end" name="End"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="receiveDefect"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="receiveDefect" targetRef="resolveOrder"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="resolveOrder" targetRef="gwTransitional"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="gwTransitional" targetRef="markTransitional"
                  ispf:condition="self.isTransitionalFlag["value"] > 0.0"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="gwTransitional" targetRef="markCurrentOrder" ispf:default="true"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="markTransitional" targetRef="gwJoinOrder"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="markCurrentOrder" targetRef="gwJoinOrder"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="gwJoinOrder" targetRef="calcRoute"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="calcRoute" targetRef="gwUserTask"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="gwUserTask" targetRef="confirmTypeA"
                  ispf:condition="self.lineTypeCode["value"] >= 1.0 && self.lineTypeCode["value"] < 2.0"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="gwUserTask" targetRef="confirmTypeB"
                  ispf:condition="self.lineTypeCode["value"] >= 2.0 && self.lineTypeCode["value"] < 3.0"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="gwUserTask" targetRef="confirmTypeD" ispf:default="true"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="confirmTypeA" targetRef="gwJoinConfirm"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="confirmTypeB" targetRef="gwJoinConfirm"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="confirmTypeD" targetRef="gwJoinConfirm"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="gwJoinConfirm" targetRef="finalizeDefect"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="finalizeDefect" targetRef="notifyRouted"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="notifyRouted" targetRef="end"/>
  </process>
</definitions>

source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE machine_state SET winding_roll = 'P1', speed_mpm = 100, meter_m = 0, last_event_label = '', machine_stop = false WHERE id = 1"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE stage_context SET is_active = true, order_no = 'DEMO-OGP-01' WHERE id = 1"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","message":"Demo stage ready"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"rows","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN ms.machine_stop THEN 'warn' WHEN ms.last_event_status = 'warn' THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS status, 'Рулон на намотке' AS characteristic, ms.winding_roll AS value FROM machine_state ms WHERE ms.id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'ok', 'Скорость машины', CONCAT(ms.speed_mpm::text, ' м/мин') FROM machine_state ms WHERE ms.id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN ms.last_event_label <> '' THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END, 'Событие машины', COALESCE(NULLIF(ms.last_event_label, ''), '—') FROM machine_state ms WHERE ms.id = 1"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"ms","sql":"SELECT winding_roll, speed_mpm::text AS speed_mpm, meter_m::text AS meter_m, last_event_label, CASE WHEN machine_stop THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS machine_stop FROM machine_state WHERE id = 1"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"st","sql":"SELECT order_no, line_count_pm::text AS line_count_pm, line_count_passer::text AS line_count_passer FROM stage_context WHERE id = 1 AND is_active = true"},{"type":"selectMany","var":"eventCodes","sql":"SELECT code, name, requires_time::text AS requires_time, requires_meter::text AS requires_meter, requires_comment::text AS requires_comment, has_subcodes::text AS has_subcodes FROM event_code ORDER BY code"},{"type":"selectMany","var":"rolls","sql":"SELECT roll_id, label, is_scrap::text AS is_scrap, is_active_winding::text AS is_active_winding FROM roll WHERE stage_id = 1 ORDER BY roll_id"},{"type":"selectMany","var":"subcodes","sql":"SELECT parent_code, code, label FROM event_subcode ORDER BY parent_code, code"},{"type":"selectMany","var":"unprocessed","sql":"SELECT id::text AS id, signal_label, to_char(start_at, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS start_at, to_char(end_at, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS end_at, member_count::text AS member_count FROM unprocessed_event WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY start_at DESC"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","windingRoll":"${ms.winding_roll}","meterM":"${ms.meter_m}","speedMpm":"${ms.speed_mpm}","lastEventLabel":"${ms.last_event_label}","machineStop":"${ms.machine_stop}","orderNo":"${st.order_no}","lineCountPm":"${st.line_count_pm}","lineCountPasser":"${st.line_count_passer}","defaultDeleteNow":"${ms.machine_stop}","eventCodes":"${eventCodes}","rolls":"${rolls}","subcodes":"${subcodes}","unprocessed":"${unprocessed}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"when","var":"input.signalType","equals":"resume","then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE machine_state SET machine_stop = false, speed_mpm = 100, last_event_label = '', last_event_status = 'ok' WHERE id = 1"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","message":"Machine resumed"}}]},{"type":"when","var":"input.signalType","equals":"stop","then":[{"type":"setVar","var":"label","value":"Останов"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE machine_state SET machine_stop = true, last_event_label = 'Останов', last_event_status = 'warn', speed_mpm = 0 WHERE id = 1"}],"else":[{"type":"when","var":"input.signalType","equals":"knife","then":[{"type":"setVar","var":"label","value":"Удар ножа"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE machine_state SET last_event_label = 'Удар ножа', last_event_status = 'warn' WHERE id = 1"}],"else":[{"type":"setVar","var":"label","value":"Нажата кнопка \"Брак\" у машины"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE machine_state SET last_event_label = 'Нажата кнопка \"Брак\" у машины', last_event_status = 'warn' WHERE id = 1"}]}]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"nowMeter","sql":"SELECT meter_m::text AS meter_m FROM machine_state WHERE id = 1"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"merged","sql":"SELECT u.id::text AS id FROM unprocessed_event u CROSS JOIN (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(setting_value AS integer) FROM app_setting WHERE setting_key = 'downtime_group_timeout_sec'), 300) AS sec) cfg WHERE u.status = 'pending' AND u.signal_label = ? AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - u.end_at)) < cfg.sec ORDER BY u.end_at DESC LIMIT 1","params":["${label}"]},{"type":"when","var":"merged","notNull":true,"then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE unprocessed_event SET end_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, end_meter = CAST(? AS numeric), member_count = member_count + 1 WHERE id = ?::uuid","params":["${nowMeter.meter_m}","${merged.id}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO unprocessed_member (id, unprocessed_id, signal_label, start_at, end_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?::uuid, ?, NOW(), NOW())","params":["${merged.id}","${label}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","merged":"yes","unprocessedId":"${merged.id}","signalLabel":"${label}"}}]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO raw_signal (id, signal_type, signal_label, start_at, end_at, start_meter, end_meter) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, GREATEST(CAST(? AS numeric) - 500, 0), CAST(? AS numeric))","params":["${input.signalType}","${label}","${nowMeter.meter_m}","${nowMeter.meter_m}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO unprocessed_event (id, signal_label, start_at, end_at, start_meter, end_meter, member_count, status) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, GREATEST(CAST(? AS numeric) - 500, 0), CAST(? AS numeric), 1, 'pending')","params":["${label}","${nowMeter.meter_m}","${nowMeter.meter_m}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"created","sql":"SELECT id::text AS id FROM unprocessed_event WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","unprocessedId":"${created.id}","signalLabel":"${label}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"rows","sql":"SELECT id::text AS id, signal_label, to_char(start_at, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS start_at, to_char(end_at, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS end_at, member_count::text AS member_count FROM unprocessed_event WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY start_at DESC"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE unprocessed_event SET status = 'deleted', delete_comment = ? WHERE id = ANY(CAST(string_to_array(?, ',') AS uuid[]))","params":["${input.comment}","${input.ids}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","message":"Deleted"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"when","var":"input.step","equals":"1","then":[{"type":"when","var":"input.eventCode","equals":"","then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"Укажите код события"}}]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":""}}]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"code","sql":"SELECT code, requires_time::text AS requires_time, requires_meter::text AS requires_meter FROM event_code WHERE code = ?","params":["${input.eventCode}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"code","message":"Unknown event code"},{"type":"when","var":"code.requires_meter","equals":"true","then":[{"type":"when","var":"input.startM","equals":"","then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"Укажите метраж начала и конца"}}]},{"type":"when","var":"input.endM","equals":"","then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"Укажите метраж начала и конца"}}]}]},{"type":"when","var":"input.deleteNow","equals":"false","then":[{"type":"when","var":"input.rollId","equals":"","then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"VALIDATION","error_message":"Укажите рулон"}}]}]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":""}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"code","sql":"SELECT code, name FROM event_code WHERE code = ?","params":["${input.eventCode}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"code","message":"Unknown event code"},{"type":"selectOne","var":"st","sql":"SELECT id FROM stage_context WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY id LIMIT 1"},{"type":"setVar","var":"statusVal","value":"Удален"},{"type":"when","var":"input.deleteNow","equals":"false","then":[{"type":"setVar","var":"statusVal","value":"Зарегистрирован"}]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"footage","sql":"SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(?::numeric, 0) - COALESCE(?::numeric, 0), 0)::text AS v","params":["${input.endM}","${input.startM}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO process_event (id, stage_id, event_code, event_name, delete_now, roll_id, start_m, end_m, start_at, end_at, whole_stage, side, rows_json, card1, card2, comment_text, status, footage, unprocessed_id) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, ?, CASE WHEN ? IN ('true','1','yes') THEN true ELSE false END, ?, CAST(? AS numeric), CAST(? AS numeric), CASE WHEN COALESCE(?, '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE (CURRENT_DATE + CAST(? AS TIME)) END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(?, '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE (CURRENT_DATE + CAST(? AS TIME)) END, CASE WHEN ? IN ('true','1') THEN true ELSE false END, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CAST(? AS numeric), CASE WHEN COALESCE(?, '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(? AS uuid) END)","params":["${st.id}","${code.code}","${code.name}","${input.deleteNow}","${input.rollId}","${input.startM}","${input.endM}","${input.startAt}","${input.startAt}","${input.endAt}","${input.endAt}","${input.wholeStage}","${input.side}","${input.rows}","${input.card1}","${input.card2}","${input.comment}","${statusVal}","${footage.v}","${input.unprocessedId}","${input.unprocessedId}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"ev","sql":"SELECT id::text AS event_id, event_code, delete_now::text AS delete_now, roll_id, start_m::text AS start_m, end_m::text AS end_m, status FROM process_event ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1"},{"type":"when","var":"input.subcodes","notEquals":"","then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO process_event_subcode (id, event_id, subcode) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), CAST(? AS uuid), trim(x) FROM unnest(string_to_array(?, ',')) AS t(x) WHERE trim(x) <> ''","params":["${ev.event_id}","${input.subcodes}"]}]},{"type":"when","var":"ev.delete_now","equals":"true","then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO roll_map_interval (id, roll_id, map_type, start_m, end_m, event_id, event_code) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), '0'), 'grey', ?::numeric, ?::numeric, ?::uuid, ?)","params":["${input.rollId}","${input.startM}","${input.endM}","${ev.event_id}","${ev.event_code}"]}],"else":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO roll_map_interval (id, roll_id, map_type, start_m, end_m, event_id, event_code, side, rows_json) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, 'white', ?::numeric, ?::numeric, ?::uuid, ?, ?, ?)","params":["${input.rollId}","${input.startM}","${input.endM}","${ev.event_id}","${ev.event_code}","${input.side}","${input.rows}"]}]},{"type":"when","var":"input.unprocessedId","notEquals":"","then":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE unprocessed_event SET status = 'processed' WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.unprocessedId}"]}]},{"type":"invoke_function","objectPath":"root.platform.devices.ogp-mes-hub","functionName":"ogp_enqueue1cExport","input":{"eventId":"${ev.event_id}"}},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","eventId":"${ev.event_id}","status":"${ev.status}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"rows","sql":"SELECT p.id::text AS id, CONCAT(p.event_code, ' - ', p.event_name) AS event_label, to_char(p.start_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS start_time, to_char(p.end_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS end_time, p.footage::text AS footage FROM process_event p JOIN stage_context s ON s.id = p.stage_id WHERE s.is_active = true AND (? = '' OR s.order_no = ?) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC","params":["${input.orderNo}","${input.orderNo}"]},{"type":"selectOne","var":"total","sql":"SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.footage), 0)::text AS total FROM process_event p JOIN stage_context s ON s.id = p.stage_id WHERE s.is_active = true AND (? = '' OR s.order_no = ?)","params":["${input.orderNo}","${input.orderNo}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}","totalFootage":"${total.total}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"ev","sql":"SELECT event_code, event_name, roll_id, start_m::text AS start_m, end_m::text AS end_m, status, comment_text, side, rows_json, card1, card2 FROM process_event WHERE id = ?::uuid","params":["${input.eventId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"ev","message":"Event not found"},{"type":"selectMany","var":"subcodes","sql":"SELECT subcode FROM process_event_subcode WHERE event_id = ?::uuid ORDER BY subcode","params":["${input.eventId}"]},{"type":"selectMany","var":"rows","sql":"SELECT 'Код' AS param, CONCAT(event_code, ' - ', event_name) AS value FROM process_event WHERE id = ?::uuid UNION ALL SELECT 'Рулон', COALESCE(roll_id, '') FROM process_event WHERE id = ?::uuid UNION ALL SELECT 'Начало, м', COALESCE(start_m::text, '') FROM process_event WHERE id = ?::uuid UNION ALL SELECT 'Конец, м', COALESCE(end_m::text, '') FROM process_event WHERE id = ?::uuid UNION ALL SELECT 'Статус', status FROM process_event WHERE id = ?::uuid UNION ALL SELECT 'Комментарий', COALESCE(comment_text, '') FROM process_event WHERE id = ?::uuid","params":["${input.eventId}","${input.eventId}","${input.eventId}","${input.eventId}","${input.eventId}","${input.eventId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}","subcodes":"${subcodes}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE process_event SET comment_text = COALESCE(?, comment_text), start_m = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::numeric, start_m), end_m = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::numeric, end_m), footage = GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::numeric, end_m) - COALESCE(NULLIF(?, '')::numeric, start_m), 0) WHERE id = ?::uuid","params":["${input.comment}","${input.startM}","${input.endM}","${input.endM}","${input.startM}","${input.eventId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","message":"Updated"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"rows","sql":"SELECT code, name, requires_time::text AS requires_time, requires_meter::text AS requires_meter, requires_comment::text AS requires_comment, has_subcodes::text AS has_subcodes, exclude_from_1c::text AS exclude_from_1c FROM event_code ORDER BY code"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO event_code (code, name, requires_time, requires_meter, requires_comment, has_subcodes, exclude_from_1c) VALUES (?, ?, CASE WHEN ? IN ('1','true') THEN true ELSE false END, CASE WHEN ? IN ('1','true') THEN true ELSE false END, CASE WHEN ? IN ('1','true') THEN true ELSE false END, CASE WHEN ? IN ('1','true') THEN true ELSE false END, CASE WHEN ? IN ('1','true') THEN true ELSE false END) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name","params":["${input.code}","${input.name}","${input.requiresTime}","${input.requiresMeter}","${input.requiresComment}","${input.hasSubcodes}","${input.excludeFrom1c}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","message":"Saved"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO event_subcode (id, parent_code, code, label) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, ?)","params":["${input.parentCode}","${input.code}","${input.label}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","message":"Subcode added"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"rows","sql":"SELECT map_type, start_m::text AS start_m, end_m::text AS end_m, event_code, side, COALESCE(rows_json, '') AS rows_json FROM roll_map_interval WHERE roll_id = ? ORDER BY start_m","params":["${input.rollId}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"st","sql":"SELECT order_no FROM stage_context WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1"},{"type":"selectMany","var":"defects","sql":"SELECT event_code, start_m::text AS start_m, end_m::text AS end_m, side, COALESCE(rows_json, '') AS rows_json FROM roll_map_interval WHERE roll_id = ? AND map_type = 'white' ORDER BY start_m","params":["${input.rollId}"]},{"type":"setVar","var":"payload","value":"{\"rollId\":\"${input.rollId}\",\"orderNo\":\"${st.order_no}\"}"},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO roll_label_data (id, roll_id, order_no, payload_json) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?, ?, ?)","params":["${input.rollId}","${st.order_no}","${payload}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rollId":"${input.rollId}","orderNo":"${st.order_no}","defects":"${defects}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"rows","sql":"SELECT s.order_no, p.event_code, p.event_name, COUNT(*)::text AS event_count, COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.end_at - p.start_at)) / 60), 0)::text AS downtime_min, COALESCE(SUM(p.footage), 0)::text AS total_footage FROM process_event p JOIN stage_context s ON s.id = p.stage_id WHERE p.delete_now = true AND (? = '' OR s.order_no = ?) GROUP BY s.order_no, p.event_code, p.event_name ORDER BY s.order_no, p.event_code","params":["${input.orderNo}","${input.orderNo}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","rows":"${rows}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"ev","sql":"SELECT p.id::text AS event_id, p.event_code, s.order_no, p.delete_now::text AS delete_now, p.roll_id, p.start_m::text AS start_m, p.end_m::text AS end_m, to_char(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD\"T\"HH24:MI:SS') AS start_at, to_char(p.end_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD\"T\"HH24:MI:SS') AS end_at, p.footage::text AS footage, COALESCE(p.side, '') AS side, COALESCE(p.rows_json, '') AS rows_json, COALESCE(p.comment_text, '') AS comment, p.status, ec.exclude_from_1c::text AS exclude_from_1c FROM process_event p JOIN stage_context s ON s.id = p.stage_id JOIN event_code ec ON ec.code = p.event_code WHERE p.id = ?::uuid","params":["${input.eventId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"ev","message":"Event not found"},{"type":"when","var":"ev.exclude_from_1c","equals":"true","then":[{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","skipped":"yes"}}]},{"type":"setVar","var":"payload","value":"{\"eventId\":\"${ev.event_id}\",\"eventCode\":\"${ev.event_code}\",\"orderNo\":\"${ev.order_no}\"}"},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO integration_outbox (id, event_id, payload_json, status) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), ?::uuid, ?, 'pending')","params":["${ev.event_id}","${payload}"]},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","enqueued":"yes"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"selectMany","var":"pending","sql":"SELECT id::text AS id, event_id::text AS event_id, payload_json FROM integration_outbox WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'sent', exported_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'pending'"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","exported":"${pending}"}}]}

{"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE machine_state SET meter_m = meter_m + speed_mpm / 60.0 * 5 WHERE id = 1 AND machine_stop = false"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":""}}]}

reports.query: SELECT s.order_no, p.event_code, p.event_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.end_at - p.start_at)) / 60), 0)::numeric, 1) AS downtime_min, COALESCE(SUM(p.footage), 0) AS total_footage FROM process_event p JOIN stage_context s ON s.id = p.stage_id WHERE p.delete_now = true AND (? = '' OR s.order_no = ?) GROUP BY s.order_no, p.event_code, p.event_name ORDER BY s.order_no, p.event_code

{"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"kpi","sql":"SELECT line_code, shift_label, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 THEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 100.0 / planned_minutes ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS availability_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN LEAST(100.0, ideal_cycle_sec * total_units * 100.0 / ((planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 60)) ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS performance_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN total_units > 0 THEN good_units * 100.0 / total_units ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS quality_pct, CAST(ROUND(CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN (CASE WHEN planned_minutes > 0 THEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 1.0 / planned_minutes ELSE 0 END) * (CASE WHEN (planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) > 0 AND total_units > 0 THEN LEAST(1.0, ideal_cycle_sec * total_units * 1.0 / ((planned_minutes - downtime_minutes) * 60)) ELSE 0 END) * (CASE WHEN total_units > 0 THEN good_units * 1.0 / total_units ELSE 0 END) * 100 ELSE 0 END, 0) AS INT) AS oee_pct FROM mes_oee_shift WHERE id = CAST(? AS uuid)","params":["${input.shiftId}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"kpi","message":"Shift not found"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","lineCode":"${kpi.line_code}","shiftLabel":"${kpi.shift_label}","availabilityPct":"${kpi.availability_pct}","performancePct":"${kpi.performance_pct}","qualityPct":"${kpi.quality_pct}","oeePct":"${kpi.oee_pct}"}}]}

-- simple linear backfill for existing measurements without volume
UPDATE oc_measurement m
SET volume_l = CASE
  WHEN m.tank_code LIKE 'RGS-%' THEN (m.level_cm / 400.0) * 8000.0
  ELSE (m.level_cm / 1200.0) * 50000.0
END
WHERE m.volume_l IS NULL;

-- V4: контур АЗС (регионы, станции, РГС–ТРК, мониторинг, KPI) под SPA «Ойл Контроль»

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_region (
  region_code VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  stations_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stations_connected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_station (
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  region_code VARCHAR(16) REFERENCES oc_region(region_code),
  address VARCHAR(256),
  lat DOUBLE PRECISION,
  lon DOUBLE PRECISION,
  connected BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  map_x DOUBLE PRECISION,
  map_y DOUBLE PRECISION
);

ALTER TABLE oc_tank ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS azs_code VARCHAR(8);
ALTER TABLE oc_tank ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tank_no INTEGER;
ALTER TABLE oc_tank ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS capacity_l DOUBLE PRECISION;
ALTER TABLE oc_tank ALTER COLUMN product_code TYPE VARCHAR(32);
ALTER TABLE oc_batch ALTER COLUMN product_code TYPE VARCHAR(32);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_imbalance (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  tank_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  period_label VARCHAR(64),
  shifts_label VARCHAR(64),
  detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  delta_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  delta_kg DOUBLE PRECISION,
  cause TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_monitor_event (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  azs_code VARCHAR(8),
  address VARCHAR(256),
  event_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_name VARCHAR(64),
  map_x DOUBLE PRECISION,
  map_y DOUBLE PRECISION,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_rgs_trk (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  site_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'АЗС',
  tank_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  rgs_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  trk_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  abs_dev_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  rel_dev_pct DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_kpi_report (
  report_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
  title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  report_group VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  period_label VARCHAR(64),
  format VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Excel',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  row_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  owner_name VARCHAR(128),
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'готов',
  summary TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_wagon_trip (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  wagon_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  from_station VARCHAR(128),
  to_station VARCHAR(128),
  waybill VARCHAR(64),
  shipped_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  current_station VARCHAR(128),
  operation VARCHAR(64),
  op_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  km_left INTEGER,
  delay_bucket VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lt1'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_tank_stock (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  address VARCHAR(256),
  tank_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  density_kg_m3 DOUBLE PRECISION,
  stock_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  fill_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  free_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  dead_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  measured_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO oc_calibration_row (calibration_id, level_cm, volume_l)
SELECT c.id, v.level_cm, v.volume_l * COALESCE(t.capacity_l, 8000) / 8000.0
FROM oc_calibration c
JOIN oc_tank t ON t.tank_code = c.tank_code
JOIN (VALUES (0::float,0::float),(200::float,4000::float),(400::float,8000::float)) AS v(level_cm, volume_l) ON true
WHERE c.tank_code LIKE 'AZS-%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oc_calibration_row r WHERE r.calibration_id=c.id AND r.level_cm=v.level_cm);

-- V5: убрать авиа/ТЗК-контур из активного демо, оставить только АЗС

-- деактивировать legacy резервуары (прирельс / расходный / перрон)
UPDATE oc_tank
SET active = false
WHERE site_code IN ('rail', 'expense', 'apron')
   OR tank_code IN ('RVS-1','RVS-2','RVS-3','RVS-4','RVS-5','RGS-1A','RGS-2A');

-- пометить legacy-площадки
UPDATE oc_site
SET display_name = CASE
  WHEN display_name LIKE '%(архив)%' THEN display_name
  ELSE display_name || ' (архив)'
END
WHERE site_code IN ('rail', 'expense', 'apron');

-- закрыть legacy-аномалии/инциденты ТЗК (не удаляем историю)
UPDATE oc_anomaly
SET status = 'closed', closed_at = COALESCE(closed_at, NOW())
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND (zone_code LIKE 'z1_%' OR zone_code LIKE 'z2_%' OR zone_code LIKE 'z3_%'
       OR zone_code LIKE 'z4_%' OR zone_code LIKE 'z5_%'
       OR title ILIKE '%ТЗА%' OR title ILIKE '%ТЗК%' OR title ILIKE '%РВС-ТЗА%');

UPDATE oc_incident
SET status = 'closed', closed_at = COALESCE(closed_at, NOW())
WHERE status IN ('new', 'assigned', 'open')
  AND (module = 'tzk' OR title ILIKE '%ТЗА%' OR title ILIKE '%ТЗК%');

-- партнёр авиа → не активен для B2B списков (оставляем запись)
UPDATE oc_b2b_order
SET status = 'cancelled'
WHERE partner_code = 'AIRLINE-SU' AND status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'closed');

-- ТЗА/ЖД транспорт в архивный статус
UPDATE oc_vehicle
SET status = 'archived'
WHERE vehicle_type IN ('tza', 'rail_tank')
   OR vehicle_code IN ('TZA-01', 'ZHD-8841');

  level_cm DOUBLE PRECISION,
  volume_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  fill_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  temp_c DOUBLE PRECISION,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_station_pump (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  pump_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'в работе',
  total_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  shift_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rate_lpm DOUBLE PRECISION,
  error_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  last_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  UNIQUE (azs_code, pump_no)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_station_journal (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  journal_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  entry_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  entry_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'открыт'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_discharge_session (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  ttn_no VARCHAR(64),
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  note TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_discharge_tank (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES oc_discharge_session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sections VARCHAR(64),
  tank_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  received_kg DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  plan_kg DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  timer_label VARCHAR(16),
  volume_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  fill_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  temp_c DOUBLE PRECISION,
  density DOUBLE PRECISION,
  density_15 DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_stock_forecast (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  bucket_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  fact_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  forecast_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  product_code VARCHAR(32)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_rgs_trk_series (

  bucket_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rgs_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_balance_trend (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  bucket_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  imbalance_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  inflow_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  outflow_l DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_kpi_card (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  total_label VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  plan_label VARCHAR(64),
  segments_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_kpi_incident_summary (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_calibration_profile (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_region_fuel (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL REFERENCES oc_region(region_code),
  product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  fill_pct DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  critical_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  UNIQUE (region_code, product_code)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_station_tank_live (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  tank_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  level_cm DOUBLE PRECISION,
  volume_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  fill_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  temp_c DOUBLE PRECISION,
  density_kg_m3 DOUBLE PRECISION,
  water_cm DOUBLE PRECISION,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'норма',
  UNIQUE (azs_code, tank_no)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_station_pump (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  pump_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'в работе',
  total_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  shift_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rate_lpm DOUBLE PRECISION,
  error_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  last_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  UNIQUE (azs_code, pump_no)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_station_journal (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  journal_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  entry_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  entry_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'открыт'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_discharge_session (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  ttn_no VARCHAR(64),
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  note TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_discharge_tank (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES oc_discharge_session(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sections VARCHAR(64),
  tank_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  received_kg DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  plan_kg DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  timer_label VARCHAR(16),
  volume_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  fill_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  temp_c DOUBLE PRECISION,
  density DOUBLE PRECISION,
  density_15 DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_stock_forecast (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  bucket_label VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  fact_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  forecast_pct DOUBLE PRECISION,
  product_code VARCHAR(32)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_rgs_trk_series (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  bucket_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  rgs_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  trk_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_balance_trend (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  bucket_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  imbalance_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  inflow_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  outflow_l DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_kpi_card (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  total_label VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  plan_label VARCHAR(64),
  segments_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  legend VARCHAR(256),
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_kpi_incident_summary (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  count_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  azs_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  mass_label VARCHAR(64),
  action_label VARCHAR(128),
  colors_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_calibration_profile (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  azs_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
  tank_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  calibrated_at DATE,
  ok_levels INTEGER,
  total_levels INTEGER
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oc_calibration_profile_row (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  profile_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES oc_calibration_profile(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  level_cm DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  viis_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  vtoir_l DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  dev_l DOUBLE PRECISION,
  dev_pct DOUBLE PRECISION
);

SELECT p.id,
  110 + g.i * 160 + (p.tank_no * 8),
  350 + g.i * 240 + (p.tank_no * 40),
  (350 + g.i * 240 + (p.tank_no * 40)) * (1 + 0.05 * sin(g.i * 0.7 + p.tank_no) + CASE WHEN g.i < 3 THEN 0.15 ELSE 0 END),
  ((350 + g.i * 240 + (p.tank_no * 40)) * (1 + 0.05 * sin(g.i * 0.7 + p.tank_no) + CASE WHEN g.i < 3 THEN 0.15 ELSE 0 END))
    - (350 + g.i * 240 + (p.tank_no * 40)),

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "-- reference query used by oc_calcBalance v2

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (tank_code) tank_code, volume_l, measured_at
  FROM oc_measurement
  WHERE volume_l IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY tank_code, measured_at DESC
),
prev AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.tank_code) m.tank_code, m.volume_l, m.measured_at
  FROM oc_measurement m
  WHERE m.volume_l IS NOT NULL
    AND m.measured_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '8 hours'
  ORDER BY m.tank_code, m.measured_at DESC
),
site_stock AS (
  SELECT t.site_code,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.volume_l), 0)::float AS stock_end_l,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(p.volume_l, l.volume_l)), 0)::float AS stock_start_l
  FROM oc_tank t
  LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.tank_code = t.tank_code
  LEFT JOIN prev p ON p.tank_code = t.tank_code
  WHERE t.active
  GROUP BY t.site_code
),
meter_delta AS (
  SELECT m.zone_code,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.meter_role = 'inflow' THEN COALESCE(r.delta_l, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0)::float AS inflow_l,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.meter_role = 'outflow' THEN COALESCE(r.delta_l, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0)::float AS outflow_l
  FROM oc_meter m
  LEFT JOIN oc_meter_reading r ON r.meter_code = m.meter_code AND r.reading_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  GROUP BY m.zone_code
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    z.zone_code,
    z.display_name,
    z.loss_norm_pct,
    z.site_code,
    COALESCE(ss.stock_end_l, 0) AS stock_end_l,
    COALESCE(ss.stock_start_l, 0) AS stock_start_l,
    COALESCE(md.inflow_l, 0) AS inflow_l,
    COALESCE(md.outflow_l, 0) AS outflow_l,
    (COALESCE(ss.stock_end_l, 0) - COALESCE(ss.stock_start_l, 0)) AS delta_stock_l
  FROM oc_zone z
  LEFT JOIN site_stock ss ON ss.site_code = z.site_code
  LEFT JOIN meter_delta md ON md.zone_code = z.zone_code
  WHERE z.site_code = 'azs-net'
)
SELECT
  zone_code,
  display_name,
  loss_norm_pct,
  ROUND(ABS(
    CASE
      WHEN inflow_l + outflow_l > 0 THEN
        (inflow_l - outflow_l - delta_stock_l) / NULLIF(GREATEST(inflow_l, outflow_l, stock_start_l, 1), 0) * 100
      ELSE
        delta_stock_l / NULLIF(GREATEST(stock_start_l, 1), 0) * 100
    END
  )::numeric, 3)::float AS imbalance_pct,
  ROUND((
    CASE
      WHEN inflow_l + outflow_l > 0 THEN inflow_l - outflow_l - delta_stock_l
      ELSE delta_stock_l
    END
  )::numeric, 1)::float AS imbalance_l,
  ROUND(stock_end_l::numeric, 1)::float AS stock_end_l,
  CASE
    WHEN ABS(
      CASE
        WHEN inflow_l + outflow_l > 0 THEN
          (inflow_l - outflow_l - delta_stock_l) / NULLIF(GREATEST(inflow_l, outflow_l, stock_start_l, 1), 0) * 100
        ELSE delta_stock_l / NULLIF(GREATEST(stock_start_l, 1), 0) * 100
      END
    ) <= loss_norm_pct THEN 'green'
    WHEN ABS(
      CASE
        WHEN inflow_l + outflow_l > 0 THEN
          (inflow_l - outflow_l - delta_stock_l) / NULLIF(GREATEST(inflow_l, outflow_l, stock_start_l, 1), 0) * 100
        ELSE delta_stock_l / NULLIF(GREATEST(stock_start_l, 1), 0) * 100
      END
    ) <= loss_norm_pct + 0.3 THEN 'yellow'
    ELSE 'red'
  END AS status,
  'live: stock Δ8h + meters 24h' AS note
FROM calc
ORDER BY zone_code"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

workflows.title: OT Alarm Classify
workflows.toolDescription: Classify an OT alarm (severity + reason). Args: alarmId (required), optional alarmMessage.
workflows.bpmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
             xmlns:ispf="http://ispf.io/bpmn"
             targetNamespace="http://ispf.io/bpmn">
  <process id="ot-alarm-classify" name="OT Alarm Classify" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start" name="Start"/>
    <serviceTask id="classify" name="LLM classify"
                 ispf:action="llm_complete"
                 ispf:promptTemplate="Classify OT alarm severity for id=${alarmId}. Message: ${alarmMessage}. Reply JSON only with keys severity (info|warning|critical) and reason."
                 ispf:outputVariable="llmClassification"
                 ispf:outputFormat="json"
                 ispf:modelRef="platform-default"
                 ispf:timeoutMs="30000"/>
    <serviceTask id="logResult" name="Log classification"
                 ispf:action="log"
                 ispf:message="ot-alarm-classify: ${alarmId} -> ${llmClassification}"/>
    <endEvent id="end" name="End"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="classify"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="classify" targetRef="logResult"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="logResult" targetRef="end"/>
  </process>
</definitions>
