source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, toir_id AS \"toirId\", level, parent_id AS parent, status, has_model AS \"hasModel\", kind, analytics, issue, pos_x AS \"posX\", pos_y AS \"posY\", pos_z AS \"posZ\", explode_x AS \"explodeX\", explode_y AS \"explodeY\", explode_z AS \"explodeZ\" FROM spa_asset ORDER BY level, name) q"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, status, kind, issue, pos_x AS \"posX\", pos_y AS \"posY\", pos_z AS \"posZ\" FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'asset' ORDER BY name) q"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, level, status, issue, has_model AS \"hasModel\", kind FROM spa_asset WHERE parent_id = ? ORDER BY name) q", "params": ["${input.parentId}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, toir_id AS \"toirId\", level, parent_id AS parent, status, has_model AS \"hasModel\", kind, analytics, issue, pos_x AS \"posX\", pos_y AS \"posY\", pos_z AS \"posZ\", explode_x AS \"explodeX\", explode_y AS \"explodeY\", explode_z AS \"explodeZ\" FROM spa_asset WHERE id = ?) q", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT id, name, kks, tag, toir_id AS "toirId", level, parent_id AS parent, status, has_model AS "hasModel", kind, analytics, issue, pos_x AS "posX", pos_y AS "posY", pos_z AS "posZ", explode_x AS "explodeX", explode_y AS "explodeY", explode_z AS "explodeZ" FROM spa_asset
            WHERE CONCAT_WS(' ', name, kks, tag, toir_id, COALESCE(issue, '')) ILIKE '%' || ? || '%'
            ORDER BY level, name
            LIMIT 50) q", "params": ["${input.query}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT a.id, a.name, a.kks, a.tag, a.level,
              COALESCE(s.status, a.status) AS status,
              COALESCE(s.issue, a.issue) AS issue
            FROM spa_asset a
            LEFT JOIN spa_snapshot s ON s.asset_id = a.id AND s.period = ?
            WHERE COALESCE(s.status, a.status) IN ('warning','alarm','critical','nodata')
            ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(s.status, a.status)
              WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'alarm' THEN 2 WHEN 'warning' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, a.name) q", "params": ["${input.period}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${row.rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json)::text AS rows FROM (SELECT
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'asset') AS aggregates,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'node') AS nodes,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_asset WHERE level = 'detail') AS details,
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spa_snapshot s

source.body: {"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, name, address, area_m2 FROM st_store WHERE id='st-101'"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, store_id, label, x, y, w, h FROM st_zone WHERE store_id='st-101' ORDER BY label"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, store_id, code, name, eq_type, status, brand, zone_label, category, shelf_meters, shelves, temperature, pos_x, pos_y, width, height, \"owner\" AS owner, dim_l, dim_w, dim_h, rotation FROM st_equipment WHERE store_id='st-101' ORDER BY code"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, store_id, name, COALESCE(equipment_id,'') AS equipment_id, compliance, version, COALESCE(category,'') AS category, COALESCE(export_name,'') AS export_name, COALESCE(folder_path,'') AS folder_path, COALESCE(author,'') AS author, COALESCE(version_label,'') AS version_label, updated_at FROM st_planogram WHERE store_id='st-101' ORDER BY name"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, planogram_id, level, height_cm, capacity_cm FROM st_planogram_shelf ORDER BY planogram_id, level DESC"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, planogram_id, shelf_level, name, brand, barcode, faces, actual_faces, depth, width_cm, price, color, status FROM st_planogram_sku ORDER BY planogram_id, shelf_level DESC, name"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, planogram_id, shelf_level, severity, message FROM st_planogram_issue ORDER BY planogram_id, shelf_level DESC"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, store_id, category, meters, share_pct, faces, COALESCE(equipment_ids,'') AS equipment_ids FROM st_shelf_space WHERE store_id='st-101' ORDER BY meters DESC"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, store_id, title, COALESCE(equipment_id,'') AS equipment_id, severity, status, COALESCE(assignee,'') AS assignee, COALESCE(reporter,'') AS reporter, COALESCE(source,'') AS source, created_at, sla_due_at, updated_at, COALESCE(resolution,'') AS resolution, COALESCE(linked_task_id,'') AS linked_task_id FROM st_incident WHERE store_id='st-101' ORDER BY created_at DESC"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, store_id, title, task_type, status, priority, COALESCE(assignee,'') AS assignee, COALESCE(equipment_id,'') AS equipment_id, due_at, created_at, updated_at, COALESCE(reporter,'') AS reporter, COALESCE(linked_incident_id,'') AS linked_incident_id, COALESCE(result_note,'') AS result_note FROM st_task WHERE store_id='st-101' ORDER BY created_at DESC"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, at_ts, COALESCE(actor,'') AS actor, COALESCE(from_status,'') AS from_status, to_status, COALESCE(comment,'') AS comment FROM st_lifecycle_event ORDER BY at_ts DESC"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, store_id, series, label, value, sort_order FROM st_kpi_point WHERE store_id='st-101' ORDER BY series, sort_order, label"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, name, protocol, health, latency_ms, COALESCE(endpoint,'') AS endpoint, COALESCE(description,'') AS description, last_sync_at FROM st_integration ORDER BY name"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectMany", "var": "rows", "sql": "SELECT id, name, email, role, COALESCE(store_id,'') AS store_id FROM st_user ORDER BY name"}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "rows": "${rows}"}}]}

{"steps": [{"type": "selectOne", "var": "row", "sql": "SELECT id, name, health, latency_ms FROM st_integration WHERE id = ?", "params": ["${input.id}"]}, {"type": "return", "fields": {"error_code": "OK", "error_message": "", "id": "${row.id}", "name": "${row.name}", "health": "${row.health}", "latency_ms": "${row.latency_ms}"}}]}

source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE tank_sim SET rate_mm_per_h = rate_bias_mm_per_h + SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 45.0 + tank_index * 0.7) * 35, level_mm = GREATEST(500, LEAST(max_level_mm - 200, level_mm + (rate_bias_mm_per_h + SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 45.0 + tank_index * 0.7) * 35) / 3600.0 * 5)), valve_open = ABS(rate_bias_mm_per_h + SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 45.0 + tank_index * 0.7) * 35) > 5, updated_at = NOW()"},{"type":"exec","sql":"UPDATE hub_sim SET line_pressure_mpa = 0.78 + SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 70.0) * 0.06, line_flow_m3h = 1180 + SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 50.0) * 80, line_temp_c = 11 + SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 90.0) * 2.5, delta_pressure_mpa = 0.03 + ABS(SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 35.0)) * 0.025, total_volume_m3 = 81000 + SIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) / 120.0) * 1200, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = 1"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":""}}]}
